drivers.notes: All series share the same (CODE) message format and the core power / shutter / input / image controls. Series-specific features (e.g. laser-light controls on HS, lens-shift codes on GS) are not exposed here; use send_command with the series' published command list when needed. Boxer / Inspire / 4KHS / Crimson use a newer JSON / Christie API and require a different driver — they are not covered here.
